notes: The module-root breadcrumb for Administration and Data Integration must use the same effective-permission child resolution as the sidebar/root landing behavior. Administration breadcrumb resolution follows the full current ADMIN_NAV_REQUIREMENTS matrix, including Cost Catalog access through any category/product CRUD capability and the email/template/mail-operation/operation-capability sections. The general Data Integration new-import breadcrumb landing requires imports.create together with fairs.read because fair selection is mandatory; imports.create alone does not produce a valid general root landing. The breadcrumb must not send a user to Backups or Imports merely because those were historical defaults. Legacy admin/data-operations routes are excluded because they resolve into the Operations surface. Backend authorization and role semantics are unchanged.
